ValidationRule.description: When a Subscription Opportunity moves on from Demo Booked to a later stage (Demo Completed, Proposal, Contract or Closed Won), requires Date Demo Scheduled, Primary Module, Primary Campaign Source, Lead Source and Lead Type. Moving back a stage or to Closed Lost isn't blocked. Honors the On/Off Switch (Run Validation Rules).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: $Setup.On_Off_Switch__c.Run_Validation_Rules__c && BEGINS(RecordType.DeveloperName, "Subscription_") && ISCHANGED(StageName) && ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Demo Booked") && ( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Demo Completed") || ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Proposal") || ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Contract") || ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won") ) && ( ISBLANK(Date_Demo_Scheduled__c) || ISBLANK(TEXT(Primary_Module__c)) || ISBLANK(CampaignId) || ISBLANK(TEXT(LeadSource)) || ISBLANK(TEXT(Lead_Type__c)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Before moving on from Demo Booked, please complete: Date Demo Scheduled, Primary Module, Primary Campaign Source, Lead Source and Lead Type.
